input_fields.name: target_version
input_fields.description: Object with required keys `host`, `spaceclaim_release`, `api_version`, and `runtime` for the exact requested target.

input_fields.name: operation_semantics
input_fields.description: Object with required keys `operation_id`, `inputs`, `outputs`, `side_effects`, and `units` for one operation semantic.

input_fields.name: known_api_signature
input_fields.description: Object with required keys `symbol`, `arguments`, `return_type`, `version`, and `source_ref`; the signature must be supplied and source-backed.

result_fields.name: api_binding
result_fields.description: Object with required keys `target_version`, `symbol`, `argument_mappings`, `return_mapping`, and `source_ref`; nullable when the common output envelope records missing signature evidence.

result_fields.name: compatibility_notes
result_fields.description: Array of strings recording compatibility limits and unverified runtime assumptions; it may be empty.

procedure: Verify that the supplied signature is source-backed and explicitly associated with the exact target version.
Match the operation's declared inputs and outputs to the signature's argument and return types without changing the semantics.
Record the qualified symbol, version, mappings, source reference, and any compatibility limits as one binding.
Return `api_binding` and `compatibility_notes` as action data, using the common output envelope for status, provenance ownership, and unresolved evidence; do not emit an executable call when unknown.
rejection_rules: Reject a missing, version-mismatched, or untraceable API signature.
Never invent a symbol, argument order, overload, return type, or compatibility claim from a generic API name.
Do not present a planning binding as proof of SpaceClaim execution or runtime compatibility.
